sections.Profile:
"Hockey Girl" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1964. Designed for two players, it features two flippers, two pop bumpers, four slingshots, four standup targets, and a roto-target.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Polo, Two player, Women, Hockey, Sports, Original Theme, Games
